scenario.title: 聊理財習慣和存錢目標
scenario.context: 講理財時一直在說目的：「為了存頭期款」「好讓我明年能出國」「以免月底沒錢」。英文用 to、in order to、so that、so as not to 表達目的，每個後面接的東西都不一樣。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.zh: 發薪日前我完全沒錢了。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: I splurged on a new camera. I bought it to start a YouTube channel.
lines.zh: 我揮霍買了一台新相機，為了開 YouTube 頻道。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ha. Well, money doesn't grow on trees.
lines.zh: 哈，錢又不會從天上掉下來。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: I know. How do you always have savings?
lines.zh: 我知道。你怎麼總是有存款？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I move 20 percent of my income into a separate account so that I don't spend it.
lines.zh: 我把收入的 20% 轉到另一個帳戶，這樣我就不會花掉。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: That's smart. I should do that in order to stop living paycheck to paycheck.
lines.zh: 聰明。我應該這樣做，才不會一直月光。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I'm pinching pennies this year to save for a trip to Iceland.
lines.zh: 我今年在省吃儉用，為了存錢去冰島。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Nice! How are you doing it?

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I cook at home so as not to spend too much on eating out.
lines.zh: 我在家煮飯，以免在外面吃花太多錢。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I track every expense in an app so that I can see where my money goes.
lines.zh: 我用 app 記每一筆支出，這樣才看得到錢花去哪了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Mostly. Except for bubble tea. That's still my weakness.
lines.zh: 大部分有用，除了珍奶。那還是我的弱點。

chinglish.wrong: I save money for buy a house.
chinglish.right: I'm saving money to buy a house. / I'm saving for a house.
chinglish.why: 表目的用 to + V，或 for + 名詞，不能 for + 原形動詞。

chinglish.wrong: I cook at home so that save money.
chinglish.right: I cook at home to save money. / …so that I can save money.
chinglish.why: so that 後面要接完整子句（主詞 + 動詞）。

chinglish.wrong: I use an app in order to not overspend.
chinglish.right: I use an app in order not to overspend. / …so as not to overspend.
chinglish.why: 否定目的的 not 放在 to 前面。

grammar.title: 目的 to / in order to / so that
grammar.oneLiner: to / in order to + 原形；so that + 主詞 + can / will / won't + 原形；否定目的用 so as not to 或 in order not to。
whenToUse: to + V：最常用。I work two jobs to save money.
in order to + V：比較正式、強調目的。We changed the process in order to save time.
so that + 子句：主詞不同或需要情態動詞時。I'll send it now so that you can review it tonight.
否定目的：so as not to / in order not to + V：I left early so as not to be late.
for + 名詞：I'm saving for a trip.（不能 for + 原形）
口語常用 so（= so that）：I wrote it down so I wouldn't forget.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「為了」「好讓」「以免」後面可以接任何結構。英文則要看後面是動詞還是子句，選 to 或 so that。台灣人最常見的錯誤是 for + 原形（for buy），以及 so that 後面漏掉主詞。

examples.correct: I'm learning English to work abroad.
examples.incorrect: I'm learning English for work abroad.

examples.correct: I'm saving for a new laptop.
I set an alarm so that I wouldn't oversleep.
examples.incorrect: I set an alarm so that not oversleep.
examples.note: so that + 主詞 + 動詞。

examples.correct: Speak quietly so as not to wake the baby.
In order to qualify, you need two years of experience.

quiz.explanation: 後面有主詞，用 so that。

I'm saving money to buy a car.
I'm saving money so that buy a car.

slang.usage: I'm broke. = 我沒錢了（通常是暫時的）。flat broke = 身無分文。

risk.note: 自嘲很常見。注意 broke 也是 break 的過去式。

examples.en: I can't go out this weekend. I'm broke.
examples.zh: 我這週末不能出去，我沒錢了。

examples.en: I was totally broke in college.

slang.usage: splurge on something = 花大錢買某樣東西。名詞 a splurge。

risk.note: 美式常用（英式較常說 splash out，第 48 單元）。

examples.en: I splurged on a fancy dinner for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我生日時揮霍吃了一頓高級晚餐。

examples.en: This bag was a total splurge, but I love it.
examples.zh: 這個包包完全是揮霍，但我好愛。

slang.usage: 非常節省地花每一塊錢。形容詞 penny-pinching。

risk.note: 說自己沒問題；說別人 penny-pinching 帶「小氣」意味。

examples.en: We're pinching pennies until we buy the house.
examples.zh: 買房前我們都在省吃儉用。

examples.en: My penny-pinching boss won't buy new chairs.
examples.zh: 我那小氣的老闆不肯買新椅子。

slang.meaning: 錢不是從天上掉下來的
slang.usage: 父母常對孩子說的話，提醒花錢要節制。

risk.note: 有點說教，朋友間用常帶玩笑。

examples.en: Another new phone? Money doesn't grow on trees, you know.
examples.zh: 又一支新手機？錢不是從天上掉下來的。

examples.en: My mom always said money doesn't grow on trees.
examples.zh: 我媽總是說錢不是從天上掉下來的。

review.question: If I had saved more last year, I ___ bought a new laptop.
review.explanation: 複習第 64 單元：type 3 用 would have + p.p.。

review.question: ___ earning more, he still can't save any money. (儘管)
Prices are expected ___ again next year.
review.explanation: 複習第 61 單元：is expected to + V。

review.question: My sister, ___ is an accountant, helps me with my taxes.
review.explanation: 複習第 57 單元：非限定子句用 who。

review.question: I ___ bought that jacket. I've never worn it.
review.explanation: 複習第 49 單元：後悔做了。

review.question: This is the ___ thing I've ever bought.
review.explanation: 複習第 33 單元：長形容詞用 most。

review.question: I ___ money for a trip this year.
review.explanation: 複習第 1 單元：這陣子的狀態用進行式。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: I'm saving for buy a car.
I'm saving to buy a car.
I'm saving so that buy a car.
